p: foot when thou goest to the: That is, with what affection you come to hear the word of God.
fools: Meaning, of the wicked, who think to please God with common uses, and have neither faith nor repentance.
rash with thy mouth: Either in vowing or in praying, meaning, that we should use all reverence toward God.
few: He hears you not for the sake of your many words or often repetitions, but considers your faith and servant's mind.
vowed: He speaks of vows which are approved by God's word and serve to his glory.
flesh to sin: Do not cause yourself to sin by vowing rashly as they do who make a vow to live unmarried and such like.
angel: That is, before God's messenger when he will examine your doing, as though your ignorance should be a just excuse.
higher than the highest regardeth: Meaning, that God will address these things, and therefore we must depend on him.
profit of the earth is for: The earth is to be preferred above all things which belong to this life.
himself is served by the field: Kings and princes cannot maintain their estate without tillage, which commends the excellency of tillage.
abundance of the rich will not: That is, his great abundance of riches, or the surfeiting, which comes by his great feeding.
kept for the owners of them: When covetous men heap up riches, which turn to their destruction.
hand: He does not enjoy his father's riches.
wind: Meaning, in vain and without profit.
darkness: In affliction and grief of mind.
eat and to drink: Read Geneva "Ec 3:22"
life: He will take no great thought for the pains that he has endured in times past.
